name: LRJ Capital
decision_note: Described in 2020 as a Slovak seed VC (Exponea, Charged Monkey, SaferPass, Athletigen), but no legal entity, own website (domain now for sale) or dated activity since 2024-10-25 could be found.

evidence.quote: This Slovakian venture capital fund’s mission is to influence the whole CEE entrepreneurial community by supporting companies with world-market leadership potential and high integrity.
LRJ Capital’s usual investment is approximately €0.5M, but the investment range varies from €100k to even over €2M.

analyst_notes: Only source found: Vestbee list of Slovak VC funds (published 2020-10-08, modified 2024-02-21), which names portfolio companies Exponea, Charged Monkey, SaferPass and Athletigen and links www.lrjcapital.com; that domain now redirects to a HugeDomains for-sale page (checked 2026-10-25). ORSR name search for 'LRJ Capital' returns no entity; 'LRJ, s.r.o.' (IČO 51157705, Žilina) is a construction company and unrelated. The vehicle may be a private holding of the investors behind it or registered abroad - not established. Vestbee field values (stage seed, sector 'Various industries') sit in tag-split fields and are not quoted; recorded as not_disclosed. Web search was unavailable during this pass, so a 2024-2026 press mention cannot be ruled out; stays unverified (E8) and would be E7 if identified.
